title: Title
repeatHint: Once it's ticked off, the next one appears by itself.
deleteForbidden: Someone else gave you this task. Only the person who created it, or your parents, can delete it.
notOnBoard: You're not on the family board yet.
notOnBoardHint: Whoever is on it shows the household their appointments and tasks for the day.
nobodyOnWall: Nobody on the wall yet. Each person turns this on under Settings › Privacy & safety › “Show my appointments and to-dos on the family wall”.

timetable.noneYet: No timetable yet: timetables are for the children who are on the family board (Settings › Privacy & safety › “Show my appointments and to-dos on the family wall”).
timetable.whoStarts: Parents or the school child can start one after signing in.
timetable.subject: Subject

wall.noPhotosHint: Settings › Sign-in & devices › {{device}}: pick a photo album or turn on “Photos from today”. The calendar works without them too.
wall.doneTitle: Afterwards the wall is just the wall again

pin.notKiosk: This wall isn't allowed to load the names right now — it isn't a kiosk device yet. On this tablet: Settings › Sign-in & devices › “Make this device the family wall”.
pin.noPins: Nobody in the household has set a kiosk PIN yet. Go to Settings › Sign-in & devices on any device, set a PIN, then tap again.
